memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason: initial evaluation of newly diagnosed type 2 diabetes.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: She reports fatigue, increased thirst, and frequent urination for 2 months. No hypoglycemia episodes.
EXAMINATION: BP 128/78 mmHg, weight 68 kg, height 1.55 m, BMI 28.3 (obese). General appearance well, no acanthosis nigricans. Cardiovascular and respiratory exams normal. Feet pulses palpable, no ulcers.
IMPRESSION: New-onset type 2 diabetes, obese. HbA1c pending. Lifestyle modification needed.
ARRANGEMENTS: Start metformin 500 mg twice daily, glimepiride 1 mg each morning before breakfast, sitagliptin 100 mg daily, empagliflozin 10 mg daily. Advise reduced carbohydrate intake, 150 mins weekly aerobic activity, weight target 5-7% loss. Return if: polyuria worsens, thirst increases, blood glucose below 70 mg/dL with symptoms, blurred vision, or foot pain.

memories.author: D03
memories.text: Metformin 500 mg BD oral; Glimepiride 1 mg OD before breakfast oral; Sitagliptin 100 mg OD oral; Empagliflozin 10 mg OD oral. Continue lifestyle advice.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: HbA1c 7.8%; Fasting plasma glucose 146 mg/dL (70-100); Urine albumin-creatinine ratio 12 mg/g (<30).

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason: 3-month diabetes follow-up.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: She feels better, less thirst, occasional mild fatigue. No hypoglycemia.
EXAMINATION: BP 126/76 mmHg, weight 66 kg, BMI 27.5 (overweight). No edema, feet normal.
IMPRESSION: HbA1c improved to 7.2%; fasting glucose 128 mg/dL. Weight loss 2 kg. Continue current regimen, consider glimepiride dose reduction.
ARRANGEMENTS: Reduce glimepiride to 0.5 mg OD before breakfast. Keep metformin 500 BD, sitagliptin 100 OD, empagliflozin 10 OD. Reinforce diet and activity. Return if: symptomatic hypoglycemia, persistent polyuria, vision change, or foot pain.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason: Routine diabetes review after medication tweak.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: She reports stable energy, occasional mild polyuria after meals. No hypoglycemia.
EXAMINATION: BP 124/74 mmHg, weight 65 kg, BMI 27.0 (overweight). Feet warm, pulses present.
IMPRESSION: HbA1c 6.9%; fasting glucose 122 mg/dL. Good control; consider metformin uptitration for further glucose lowering.
ARRANGEMENTS: Increase metformin to 850 mg BD. Keep glimepiride 0.5 mg OD, sitagliptin 100 OD, empagliflozin 10 OD. Advise maintain carb moderation, 150 mins weekly exercise. Return if: symptomatic hypoglycemia, worsening polyuria, blurry vision, or foot ulcer.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason: Annual diabetes review.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: She feels well, no polyuria or thirst, occasional mild fatigue after long drives. No hypoglycemia.
EXAMINATION: BP 122/72 mmHg, weight 64 kg, BMI 26.6 (overweight). Feet intact.
IMPRESSION: HbA1c 6.7%; fasting glucose 118 mg/dL; urine albumin-creatinine ratio 8 mg/g. Stable control, slight weight loss.
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue metformin 850 BD, glimepiride 0.5 OD, sitagliptin 100 OD, empagliflozin 10 OD. Reinforce diet, activity, weight goal 60 kg. Return if: symptomatic hypoglycemia, persistent polyuria, vision changes, or foot injury.
